grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Li Ming's Busy Weekend
instructions: 这是为A1学习者编写的模拟阅读材料（非官方考试）。请先阅读短文，然后完成8道题。单选题请选择完整答案；填空题请用原文中的一个词填空，注意maxWords限制。所有解释为中文，证据为原文原句。
passage:
A. Last Saturday, Li Ming was at home in the morning. He was not hungry, so he did not eat breakfast. He wanted to relax, because he was tired. He watched TV for one hour.

B. In the afternoon, Li Ming went to the library. He met his friend Wang Fang there. They read books together. Then Li Ming went to the sports center. He played basketball with three friends. He was happy because he won the game.

C. Next Saturday, Li Ming is going to visit his grandmother. He is going to take a bus to her house. He is going to buy some fruit for her. He is going to stay there for two hours. He is going to come home at six o'clock.

questions.prompt: 上周六上午，李明在哪里？
questions.explanation: 原文第一段第一句说'Last Saturday, Li Ming was at home in the morning.'，所以他在家。
questions.evidence: Last Saturday, Li Ming was at home in the morning.

questions.prompt: 李明为什么没有吃早饭？
questions.explanation: 原文说'He was not hungry, so he did not eat breakfast.'，意思是他不饿，所以没吃早饭。
questions.evidence: He was not hungry, so he did not eat breakfast.

questions.prompt: 李明在图书馆遇到了谁？
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说'He met his friend Wang Fang there.'，there指图书馆，所以他遇到了王芳。
questions.evidence: He met his friend Wang Fang there.

questions.explanation: 原文说'He was happy because he won the game.'，他高兴是因为赢了比赛。
questions.evidence: He was happy because he won the game.

questions.prompt: 请用原文中的一个词填空：李明下午在体育中心打了________。
questions.explanation: 原文说'He played basketball with three friends.'，他打篮球，所以填basketball。
questions.evidence: He played basketball with three friends.

questions.prompt: 请用原文中的一个词填空：李明想________，因为他累了。
questions.explanation: 原文说'He wanted to relax, because he was tired.'，他想放松，所以填relax。
questions.evidence: He wanted to relax, because he was tired.

questions.prompt: 下周六李明打算做什么？
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说'Next Saturday, Li Ming is going to visit his grandmother.'，他打算看望奶奶。
questions.evidence: Next Saturday, Li Ming is going to visit his grandmother.

questions.prompt: 请用原文中的一个词填空：李明打算乘________去奶奶家。
questions.explanation: 原文说'He is going to take a bus to her house.'，他打算乘公共汽车，所以填bus。
questions.evidence: He is going to take a bus to her house.

vocabulary.example: He met his friend Wang Fang.
He is going to visit his grandmother.
He is going to buy some fruit.

grammar.title: was / were；常用过去式；be going to；because
grammar.explanation: was/were表示过去的状态，was用于I/he/she/it，were用于you/we/they。常用过去式如went, met, played, won表示过去发生的动作。be going to表示计划或打算做某事。because用来说明原因。
grammar.example: He was happy because he won the game.

questions.evidence: She went to the park yesterday.

questions.prompt: Next week, he ________ visit his uncle.
questions.explanation: Next week表示将来计划，用be going to，主语he用is。
questions.evidence: Next week, he is going to visit his uncle.

part1: What did you do last weekend?
Are you going to do anything next weekend?
speaking.part2: Describe your last weekend. You should say:
part3: Do you often stay at home on weekends?
What did you do with your friends last month?
Are you going to travel next year?

transfer.writing: Write 5 sentences about your last weekend and your plan for next weekend. Use was/were, past tense verbs, be going to, and because.
